caseName: United States v. Schneer's Atlanta, Inc.
caseNameFull: United States v. Schneer's Atlanta, Inc.
attorneys: Samuel D. Slade argued the cause for the United States. With him on the brief were Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Doub and B. Jenkins Middleton. M. H. Blackshear, Jr. argued the cause and filed a brief for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The judgment of the Court of Appeals is reversed and the judgment of the United States District Court for the Northern District of Georgia is reinstated. Defense Production Act of 1950, § 706 (b), 64 Stat. 817, 50 U. S. C. App. § 2156 (b).
